instruction: I prefer Verdana for modern web interfaces. Could you set Chrome's sans-serif font to Verdana?

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the sans-serif font family to Verdana. The evaluator checks if the sansserif_font_family in Chrome preferences matches 'Verdana' (case-insensitive). Sans-serif fonts are widely used on the web for their clean, modern appearance.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Chrome's sans-serif font setting from webkit.webprefs.fonts.sansserif.Zyyy in the Preferences file
Metric performs appropriate case-insensitive comparison of font family name with expected value 'Verdana'
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (set sans-serif font to Verdana) and evaluator checks exactly that
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are persisted to disk before verification
Expected value 'Verdana' is semantically correct for the instruction requirement
Proper error handling in getter with fallback to default value
Data flow is logically correct: getter extracts right state, metric compares correctly, expected value matches instruction
